title: SkyBot Learning
description: learning.jsonl, one record per segment, flattened into learning_kv (dotted keys). Reward is SIGNED per source; read the scoreboard (logs), not the reward total (CLAUDE.md section 9).

panels.title: Logs this run (all streams, latest segment)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(value) AS logs_run FROM learning_kv WHERE key LIKE 'outcomes.%.logs_run' AND seq = (SELECT MAX(seq) FROM learning_kv)

panels.description: outcomes.stream-N.logs_run summed. History: 35 logs in 13,305 breaks; chopping a tree has never been learned.

panels.title: Breaks this run (all streams, latest segment)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(value) AS breaks_run FROM learning_kv WHERE key LIKE 'outcomes.%.breaks_run' AND seq = (SELECT MAX(seq) FROM learning_kv)

panels.title: Logs + breaks per segment, by stream

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, replace(key, 'outcomes.', '') AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'outcomes.%.logs_segment' OR key LIKE 'outcomes.%.breaks_segment') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

panels.title: Reward by source (SIGNED sum per segment)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, replace(key, 'reward.', '') AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'reward.%') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

panels.description: reward.stream-N.<source>. Signed: a cost shows below zero. A source that pays while the agent does nothing is the recurring failure (CLAUDE.md 4.3/4.4) -- compare with behaviour.still_frac below.

panels.title: Reward mix: intrinsic through damp -> GUI zero -> mix

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, replace(key, 'reward_mix.', '') AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'reward_mix.%.intrinsic_%' OR key LIKE 'reward_mix.%.mixed_sum') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

panels.description: intrinsic_raw_sum vs intrinsic_after_damp vs intrinsic_after_gui_zero: where intrinsic reward is removed.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, replace(key, 'reward_mix.', '') AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'reward_mix.%.w_%' OR key LIKE 'reward_mix.%.farm_damp_mean' OR key LIKE 'reward_mix.%.habituation_mean') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

SELECT wall_time AS time, replace(replace(key, 'behaviour.', ''), '.action_entropy_bits', '') AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'behaviour.%.action_entropy_bits') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

panels.title: GUI / still fraction

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, replace(key, 'behaviour.', '') AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'behaviour.%.gui_frac' OR key LIKE 'behaviour.%.still_frac') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

panels.description: Time inside a GUI and time standing still. The villager trade-menu incident was 10,149 consecutive GUI steps.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, replace(replace(key, 'behaviour.', ''), '.gui_longest_run', '') AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'behaviour.%.gui_longest_run') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

panels.title: Action source: policy vs option slots

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, replace(key, 'behaviour.', '') AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'behaviour.%.source_hist.%') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time
SELECT replace(key, 'behaviour.', '') AS action, value AS count FROM learning_kv WHERE key LIKE 'behaviour.%.action_hist.%' AND seq = (SELECT MAX(seq) FROM learning_kv) ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT replace(key, 'outcomes.', '') AS block, value AS breaks FROM learning_kv WHERE key LIKE 'outcomes.%.breaks_by_type.%' AND seq = (SELECT MAX(seq) FROM learning_kv) ORDER BY value DESC
